subject: SCC module selection for EU/UK transfers — request for evidence pack and DocuSign
messages:
From: Sara Larson <sara.larson@dataprotec.co>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: SCCs — module confirmation + evidence pack request

Hi Michael,

We're finalising our vendor data transfer review for Northridge Therapeutics and need confirmation of which Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) module Redwood intends to execute for EU -> US transfers. Specifically:

- Please confirm the SCC module (Controller->Processor vs Processor->Processor) you will sign.
- Confirm whether the UK Addendum will be included for UK data.
- Share the evidence pack you can provide: SOC 2 Type II excerpt, DPIA summary, subprocessor list, and a short note on key management (KMS/HSM).
- If you can, provide a DocuSign link or timeline for when the executed SCCs would be available.

We'd like to complete this step before our security committee meeting next week.

Thanks,
Sara Larson
Data Protection Officer
Northridge Therapeutics

Attachment: none (initial request)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: SCCs — module confirmation + evidence pack request

Team — forwarding Northridge's request. Quick asks:

- Which SCC module should we commit to here (we're vendor/processor for most customers, so Module 2 seems likely).
- Confirm we will attach UK Addendum for UK-personal-data flows.
- Neha: can you assemble the evidence pack (SOC2 excerpt, DPIA summary, subprocessor list, short KMS note)?
- Marissa: any legal flags on committing to Module 2 + UK Addendum or alternate language we should expect?

Customer wants a DocuSign link/timeline before their security committee next week. Can we turn around in 3 business days?

Thanks — I can coordinate the outbound to Sara.

--
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SCC module recommendation

Michael —

I agree that Module Two (Controller -> Processor) is the correct baseline for our typical relationship where customer is controller and Redwood is processor. A few notes from legal:

- Confirm the UK Addendum will be appended for UK personal data transfers — that's standard for us.
- If the customer insists on Processor -> Processor flows (Module Three) for certain subprocessors, we can consider, but we should flag that for scoping and potentially add limited redlines around security obligations and subprocessors.
- I'll prepare our SCC template (Module Two) with the UK Addendum and a brief cover letter. Avoid broad liability expansions in front-line redlines.

Neha — please include:
- SOC 2 Type II extract focusing on controls relevant to data transfers and encryption
- DPIA summary for cloud-hosted inference 
- Current subprocessor list and data flow diagram (high level)
- KMS/HSM note (regions + customer-managed key options if available)

If security can assemble by end of day Thursday (31 Jul), I'll upload the template to DocuSign and share the envelope.

-Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 09:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SCC module recommendation — evidence pack

Team — attaching the items Marissa requested. Short summary below.

Attachments attached to this reply:
- SOC2-TypeII-Extract-Redwood-2024.pdf (excerpt: CC5, CC7, CC8 controls highlighted)
- DPIA-summary-Redwood-2025.docx (summary of data flows, risks, mitigations)
- Subprocessor-Register-Redwood-2025.csv (current subprocessors and locations)
- SCCs-Module2-UK-Addendum-template.pdf (legal template prepared by Marissa)

Quick answers:
- Recommended module: Module Two (Controller -> Processor) with the UK Addendum appended. This matches how customers send inference requests to our hosted runtime.
- Subprocessor chain: We use cloud provider EU regions for EU data by default; US region processing only occurs if customer requests cross-region routing (we note any such routing in account config).
- KMS: We offer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) via our KMS integration for Dedicated/Private customers; hosted customers use our managed KMS in region with HSM-backed keys.

Timeline: we can have the DocuSign envelope ready by EOD Thu (31 Jul) and the completed signature within 3 business days, assuming no heavy redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Larson <sara.larson@dataprotec.co>, legal@northridge-thera.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 12:02:00 +0100
Subject: SCCs and evidence pack for Northridge Therapeutics — Module Two + UK Addendum

Hi Sara,

Thanks for the note and for outlining what you need. Per our internal review: we will execute the SCCs under Module Two (Controller -> Processor) and append the UK Addendum for UK-personal-data transfers. Attached is the evidence pack we discussed:

- SOC2-TypeII-Extract-Redwood-2024.pdf (excerpt)
- DPIA-summary-Redwood-2025.docx
- SCCs-Module2-UK-Addendum-template.pdf
- Subprocessor-Register-Redwood-2025.csv

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/placeholder/EnvelopeID-12345 (Marissa will be the sender). We expect the envelope to be live by end of day today.

Notes / quick points:
- If Northridge requires Processor -> Processor wording for a particular data flow, please flag which flow and we'll review.
- If you require customer-managed keys for this account, let me know and I'll loop in Solutions to confirm options and lead time.

Next steps:
1) Review attached SCC template and evidence pack.
2) If OK, expect DocuSign envelope by EOD Thu; signers from Northridge to be indicated in reply.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this. Let me know if you want a short call to walk through the DPIA highlights.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Extract-Redwood-2024.pdf (attached), DPIA-summary-Redwood-2025.docx (attached), SCCs-Module2-UK-Addendum-template.pdf (attached)
From: Sara Larson <sara.larson@dataprotec.co>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 15:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SCCs and evidence pack for Northridge Therapeutics — Module Two + UK Addendum

Michael —

Received, thanks. We'll review the evidence pack and the Module Two + UK Addendum template. Northridge's legal team (legal@northridge-thera.com) will review and either sign or provide targeted redlines by end of next week.

Two quick clarifications for our security committee:
- Can you confirm the encryption-at-rest algorithm and whether customer-managed keys are available on the hosted plan (not just Dedicated)?
- Please confirm whether any US-based subprocessors will see EU-personal-data in the normal course (Neha's note suggests only if cross-region routing is requested).

If needed, we'll request a 30-minute call for the DPIA walk-through after our internal review.

Thanks,
Sara
DPO, Northridge Therapeutics
